title: 4610--WATER PURIFICATION SYSTEM HAMPTON VAMC/DIALYSIS
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.246-NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 6 (36C246)
detail_text: VAMC Hampton is looking for a Water Purification system with the following: - Salient Characteristics - Water Purification System that can produce not less than 200 liters of water per hour, fitted with deionization capabilities - MODEL MEDICA-R 200 - Make-up rate 15C 200 l/hr - Delivery flow rate maximum115V, 60Hz 21 l/min @ 45psi (3bar) Inorganics (resistivity @25Â°C) >10 M -cm (1) - Organics (TOC) - typical 250 Softener or use very low RO recovery3 - Free chlorine: Cl2ppm 0.5 Cylinder of carbon sized correctly to obtain 0.5 Cylinder of carbon sized correctly to obtain 30 20 inch cartridge depth filter or use very low RO recovery (4) - Fouling index: FI 20 Back washable media filter with a minimum flow rate of 20 l/min - Iron/manganese: Fe/Mn ppm 0.05 20 inch cartridge depth filter (5) - >0.1 Back-washable Fe filter (6) - Organics: TOC ppm C 3 Carbon sized Cylinder correctly for TOC demand (4) Temperature: 4 - 40Â°C (Recommended 15 - 25Â°C) -- Flowrate: (requirement at 15Â°C) 20 l/min - Drain requirements: (gravity fall with air gap) 45 l/min - Feedwater pressure: 60psi (4bar) maximum, 30psi (2bar) minimum - Notes: 3) Check LSI, increase frequency of acid cleaning, 4) Increase frequency of alkaline cleaning, - 5) Please use ELGA Part Numbers LA683 (Filter Housing) and LC172 (Carbon Filter), 6) Increase frequency of acid cleaning Wall mount canister filter will need (Wall backing required) - Must include Installation, Commissioning, Training - Electrical Requirements Mains Input: 115V, 60Hz - System control voltage (not including pumps and UV) 24V dc Power consumption (peak demand): 2000VA - Electrical protection rating 20 amps Noise level during recirculation <70dBA - ***Note: System requires approximately 4' x 6' of floor space for tanks, filtration Unit, and filters. - -The floor drain must be a minimum of 3" and meet all applicable building codes and system requirements - -Actual Unit measurement 32" Wide x35"Deep x72"High
